buttons.label: API Health
buttons.description: Check API status, DB connectivity, and which services are configured. Read-only.

buttons.label: API Logs
buttons.description: Show the last 40 lines of the API log (pm2 process 'isp-api'). Read-only.

buttons.label: Restart API
buttons.command:
pm2 restart isp-api --update-env
sleep 2
pm2 logs isp-api --lines 20 --nostream
buttons.description: Restart the Node API and show recent logs.

buttons.label: Routes Finder
buttons.description: List all API source JS files. Read-only.

buttons.label: DB Table Count
buttons.command: cd /home/ashraf/Node.js_API/j2-api && . scripts/dbenv.sh && psql -t -c "SELECT count(*) AS public_tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';"
buttons.description: Count public tables in the ispdb database, using the API's own credentials (no sudo). Read-only.

buttons.label: Backup Database
buttons.command: cd /home/ashraf/Node.js_API/j2-api && . scripts/dbenv.sh && mkdir -p ~/backups/db && pg_dump | gzip > ~/backups/db/ispdb_$(date +%F_%H%M).sql.gz && ls -lh ~/backups/db/ | tail -3
buttons.description: Dump the ispdb database to a timestamped gzip file under ~/backups/db/.

buttons.label: Unlock All Locked Users
buttons.command: cd /home/ashraf/Node.js_API/j2-api && . scripts/dbenv.sh && psql -c "UPDATE subscriber_auth SET failed_attempts=0, locked_until=NULL WHERE locked_until IS NOT NULL;"
buttons.description: Clear failed-login lockouts for any currently-locked portal accounts. Non-destructive.

buttons.label: Clear My Session (browser)
buttons.description: Clear admin auth cookies/localStorage in your own browser (client-side only).
